model: HVLS and General Ventilation Fan Control (ECPM03, Protocessor BACnet)
equipment_type: HVLS / ventilation fan control panel (up to 10 fans)
applies_to: CaptiveAire HVLS and general ventilation fan control packages with the ECPM03 board and the factory Protocessor BACnet gateway.
summary: CaptiveAire's HVLS control package runs up to ten VFD-driven fans in up to ten groups, switching them from room temperature, HMI buttons or the BMS. A factory-wired Protocessor gateway gives BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP access to temperatures, per-fan VFD data, group settings and fault flags. With DDC mode enabled the BMS can put each group in DDC Auto or DDC Manual, switch groups on and off, and set occupied speed and fan direction.
notes: The table has no read/write column. The Analog Variable and Binary Value objects carry LON input variables and are shown as writable; all inputs are read-only.
The manual's 'Object ID' numbers run 1-307 across all object types; they are used here as the instance of the printed type ('Analog Variable' listed as AV).
Per-fan objects are F1-F10 and per-group objects G1-G10; objects for fans or groups that are not installed have no meaning.

Group settings (modulation band, min/max frequency, activation temperature) are printed with one implied decimal, e.g. 72.5 °F is read as 725. The other temperature and frequency points say '1 decimal precision' without giving the scaling.
The manual prints no units for the room/HMI temperature points; the group settings are in °F.
VFD fault code meanings are in the manual's VFD fault list (0 = no fault).

source.title: High Volume Low Speed (HVLS) Fan - HVLS and General Ventilation Fan Control Software - Installation, Operation, and Maintenance Manual

integration.summary: Enable DDC mode on the HVLS controller so start and stop commands come over the network. For each fan group, write ModeG to DDC Auto (the controller runs the fans from its temperature sensors) or DDC Manual, and in Manual write ButtonG to switch the group on or off. SpeedF sets the occupied speed in Hz; monitor StateVFD, frequency and the fault flags.

minimum_points.name: ButtonG1
minimum_points.why: Group 1 on/off in DDC Manual (1 = on)

minimum_points.name: StateVFD1
minimum_points.why: Fan 1 run state and reason code

minimum_points.name: VFDFaultF1
minimum_points.why: Fan 1 VFD fault code (0 = no fault)

integration.enable: Set the controller's DDC Mode menu to ENABLED; then all fan start and stop commands come from the network. Per group, ModeG selects DDC Auto (temperature control) or DDC Manual (ButtonG on/off).
setup: Protocessor default device instance 50000; MS/TP MAC 127 and 38400 baud by default, set in the Protocessor web configurator (Configure > Profile Configuration).
Protocessor default IP 192.168.1.24; change it under Diagnostics and Debugging > Setup > Network Settings, then restart.
The Protocessor is factory set to one field protocol; objects are reachable only on that port.
gotchas: Each change in the Protocessor web configurator needs its own Submit and restarts the gateway.
Group settings use one implied decimal (725 = 72.5 °F).
Objects for fans or groups that are not installed still appear in the list.
